assertions.text: Policy thresholds (650/600 credit scores) appear in a dedicated policy column (e.g. 'Credit threshold') separate from the applicant's actual credit score column.
assertions.evidence: No dedicated threshold column in table

assertions.text: Cell values use concrete domain terms (e.g. '70', '650', 'APPROVED') — not abstract codes like 'CATEGORY_A' or '1'.
assertions.evidence: Values: 700, 651, 650, true, false, APPROVED, REJECTED, PENDING_REVIEW

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: Leftmost column 'Scenario' with entries like 'Standard approval'

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions ('Senior at lower threshold', 'Missing income') — not outcomes ('Approved', 'Rejected').
Column names use domain/business language (e.g. 'Age', 'Credit score', 'Stable income', 'Decision?') — not code identifiers like 'customerAge', 'boolean'.
assertions.evidence: Columns: Customer Age, Credit Score, Has Income?, Approval Status?

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Decision?' or 'Status?')
assertions.evidence: 'Has Stable Income?' and 'Approval Status?' end with '?'

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +.
Multiple tables (or @TableTest methods) are used, each addressing a distinct concern — not one monolithic table mixing unrelated rules.
assertions.evidence: Single @TableTest method mixes age boundaries, credit thresholds, income

assertions.text: Each table has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules — no unnecessary permutations from combining concerns.
assertions.evidence: 12-row table combines age, credit, and income concerns

assertions.text: Age boundary policy, credit score categorisation, and income status are separated into distinct @TableTest methods, with a method combining these for the expected verdict
assertions.evidence: One method present; requires distinct @TableTest methods
